reason: The passage contains explicit expressions of Yahweh's complaint about the people. In Numbers 14:11, God says to Moses: 'How long will this people provoke/despise me (יְנַאֲצֻנִי)? How long will they not believe in me despite all the signs I have done?' Furthermore, in Numbers 14:27, God explicitly states His dissatisfaction with 'this evil congregation' and declares He has heard their complaints against Him. The entire section from 14:11-35 records God's expression of displeasure with the people's faithlessness and rebellion, culminating in His pronouncement of judgment.
